name: single-leg-snatch-grip-romanian-deadlift
instructions:
1. Position the bar over the top of your shoelaces and assume a hip width stance.
2. Assume a double overhand snatch grip just outside of hip width and deadlift the weight into position at the top with the hips and knees locked out.
3. Begin the RDL by lifting one foot, unlocking your knee, and slowly hinging back into your hip.
4. Push through the floor and extend the hip as you return to the starting position.
5. Reset and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
